spans.s:
soṣyantī-karma
(‘a rite for a woman about to deliver’)
------------------------------------------
This is a very ancient rite meant for the safe delivery of the baby, from the मोथेर् who is in labour pains. The mantras from the Ṛgveda (5.78.7-9) and the Atharvaveda (1.1

) are used as prayers and magical chants for the safety of both the मोथेर् and the baby.
Keeping the Tūryantī plant at the feet of the woman about to deliver the baby and sprinkling the water collected from a river or a spring on her head by her husband with appropriate mantras is an important aspect of this rite.
